_comment: OWASP Top 10 (2021) — the fundamental web risk taxonomy — mapped to CWE and Blitz Strike coverage.

risks.name: Broken Access Control
risks.desc: Missing/weak authorization on object, function, or property access.

risks.name: Cryptographic Failures
risks.desc: Weak/absent encryption, hardcoded keys, weak randomness.

risks.name: Insecure Design
risks.desc: Design flaws (missing rate-limit, weak reset, flawed business logic).

risks.name: Security Misconfiguration
risks.desc: Exposed debug/admin, verbose errors, missing headers, CORS, XXE-enabled parsers.

risks.name: Identification and Authentication Failures
risks.desc: Weak auth, session fixation, credential stuffing, weak JWT/OAuth.

risks.name: Software and Data Integrity Failures
risks.desc: Insecure deserialization, unverified updates/plugins, CI/CD tampering.

risks.name: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
risks.desc: Missing logging/detection (a monitoring gap, not an exploit).
risks.blitz: report as a gap — note the absence of detection in the report

risks.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
risks.desc: The server fetches an attacker-influenced URL.
